copy_safety_rules: Use only model-core scores, sanitized evidence, and backend-provided job metadata.
Never expose raw CV text, prompt text, tokens, storage keys, DB URLs, email, phone, address, or unrelated PII.
Never invent skills, seniority, salary, companies, jobs, certifications, hiring outcomes, or protected-class claims.
Preserve numeric scores, model identity, analyzedAt, recommendation IDs, order, and membership.
